earnings.title: 414 Nicollet Mall
highlights: Third quarter diluted GAAP and ongoing earnings per share were $1.52 in 2026 compared with GAAP earnings of $0.88 and ongoing earnings of $1.24 in 2025.
Year-to-date diluted GAAP earnings per share were $3.34 in 2026 compared with $2.47 in 2025.
Year-to-date diluted ongoing earnings per share were $3.37 in 2026 compared with $2.84 in 2025.
Xcel Energy’s long-term annual growth objectives reflect earnings per share growth of 6-8+% and dividend growth of 4-6%.
outlook: Xcel Energy narrows its 2026 ongoing earnings per share guidance to $4.10 to $4.16.
Xcel Energy initiates its 2027 ongoing earnings per share guidance of $4.48 to $4.62.

items.heading: Our natural gas and electric generation/transmission and distribution operations involve numerous risks that may result in accidents and other operating risks and costs.
Our utility operations, resource adequacy and system reliability are subject to long-term planning and project risks.
Our utilities are highly dependent on suppliers to deliver components in accordance with short and long-term project schedules.
We are subject to physical and financial risks associated with climate change and other weather, natural disaster and resource depletion impacts.
Our utilities have significant risks associated with wildfires.
We are subject to commodity risks and other risks associated with energy markets and energy production.
